brief:
Two Palestinian men were shot by Israeli occupation forces on Thursday in the Batn al-Sameen area south of Khan Younis in southern Gaza, Shehab Wire reported. One of the men sustained serious injuries in the incident.

Local sources said the troops opened fire in the vicinity, though further details on the circumstances of the shooting remained unclear. The incident marked the latest reported armed confrontation in the southern Gaza strip.

title: Israeli forces shoot two Palestinians south of Khan Younis.
